title: Every <button> (Button primitive, accordion triggers, copy buttons, password toggles, header Login, footer buttons) shows cursor: default
evidence: Computed-style probe in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/results.json: noPointer lists BUTTON "Sign In", "Send Reset Email", "Search" (404), all 8 FAQ triggers, 5 MCP "Copy" buttons, "Show password", header "Login", footer "v0.13.2"/"View disclaimer"; links are pointer. Labels for inputs also default.
impact: Clickable controls look inert next to links that do show a hand; inconsistent affordance across the app (Tailwind v4 dropped the preflight button cursor).
fix: Add one base rule in assets/main.css @layer base: button:not(:disabled), [role=button], summary, label[for], input[type=checkbox] { cursor: pointer } (and cursor-not-allowed on disabled); remove ad-hoc cursor classes.

title: Error text using text-destructive fails AA in light mode (3.3:1)
evidence: Probe on /reset-password (no token) light: alert text and its link ratio 3.29 at 14px. Same classes on /login wrong-credentials alert (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-login-wrong-light.png), field errors "Required", forgot-password error, Profile "Passwords do not match" (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-profile-mismatch-light.png). Admin role badge (destructive) 3.81:1.
impact: Error messages, the single most important text on a failing form, are below WCAG 1.4.3 for low-vision users.
fix: Split the token: keep --destructive for fills/borders, add --destructive-foreground-text (e.g. oklch(0.5 0.2 25) light) used by text-destructive and alert text; verify >= 4.5:1 on card and on bg-destructive/10.

title: "secondary" token is saturated violet, so every static Badge and secondary Button renders as a loud purple pill
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/about-desktop-light.png: "Filter by evidence score", "JSON export", "Multi-source annotations" are filled violet pills; "View Documentation" button violet. /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/mcp-desktop-light.png: "Read-only", "Public — no API key", example prompts as violet pills.
impact: Non-interactive labels look like primary actions; violet competes with tier and source colours and has no meaning (violates "one colour language").
fix: Make --secondary a neutral (shadcn default zinc-100 / zinc-800) and introduce an explicit accent token only where a meaning exists; static feature labels should be plain text or neutral outline chips.

title: Raw palette colours and hex values outside the token layer (bg-green-600, bg-blue-600, bg-amber-600, #8b5cf6, gradient hexes, green-500 success boxes)
evidence: 32 raw palette/hex occurrences in the content views (grep). About icon discs green/blue/#8b5cf6 (About.vue:72,105,129,234), concept gradients (About.vue:316,329,342), MCP bg-green-600/bg-amber-600 (MCP.vue:129,151), success boxes green-500 (ForgotPassword.vue:91, ResetPassword.vue:117, Profile.vue:194), Active badge green-100 (Profile.vue:59).
impact: Colour carries no consistent meaning (green = "evidence scores" on About, "start here" on MCP, "success" in forms); dark-mode tuning is per call site.
fix: Add --success/--warning/--info tokens (+ foreground) and an IconDisc primitive with a neutral or primary tint; replace raw classes.

title: No type scale: h1 and h2 are both 24px; card h3 (16px/600) is heavier than section h2 (500); FAQ h2 is 16px/400
evidence: Heading probe: About H1 24px/700, H2 24px/500, H3 16px/600, concept H3 18px/700; MCP identical; FAQ H2 16px/400; Login/Forgot/Reset H1 24px/500 vs content H1 24px/700; 404 H1 60px. 10.5px and 11px text present in footer.
impact: Section headings do not read as a level below the page title; reading pages lose their outline, hurting comprehension in Read mode.
fix: Define a PageHeader + SectionHeading primitive (h1 30/700, h2 20/600, h3 16/600) or @layer base h1–h3 defaults; replace the copy-pasted header blocks in About/MCP/Profile/Dashboard/DataSources.

title: Two validation/error patterns: auth pages use vee-validate with inline field errors; Profile uses a single Alert under the form with no inline message and a neutral-border destructive Alert
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-profile-mismatch-light.png: red ring on confirm field but message sits in a separate white-bordered box below; Login shows inline red text under each field and a pink-filled alert box (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-login-wrong-light.png).
impact: Users learn two error grammars; the Alert destructive variant (bg-card, no red border) looks different from the hand-rolled alert boxes on auth pages.
fix: Create FormField (Label + Input + inline error with aria-describedby) and FormAlert (error/success) primitives; move Profile to vee-validate/zod like the auth pages.

title: Error/success callouts are hand-rolled divs repeated 6 times instead of the Alert primitive
evidence: Identical class strings "rounded-md border border-destructive/50 bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-sm text-destructive" in Login.vue:163, ForgotPassword.vue:98, ResetPassword.vue:72 and :125; green variants at ForgotPassword.vue:91, ResetPassword.vue:120.
impact: Drift risk and inconsistent look vs the Alert used on Profile/MCP.
fix: Add tinted destructive/success variants to components/ui/alert and use them everywhere.

title: Auth and profile pages all have the generic document title "KGDB - Kidney Genetics Database"; route meta.title is never applied
evidence: results.json title field for login/forgot/reset/profile = "KGDB - Kidney Genetics Database"; router meta.title set (router/index.ts:125-143) but no code reads meta.title (grep).
impact: WCAG 2.4.2 Page Titled: tabs, history and screen readers cannot distinguish the pages.
fix: Set document.title from meta.title in router.afterEach (or call useSeoMeta with noindex in each view).

title: Page-header icon is vertically centred against a multi-line title block on mobile, floating beside the subtitle
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/mcp-mobile-dark.png and about-mobile-dark.png: plug/info icon sits mid-way down the 3-line header, left of the subtitle, not aligned with the h1.
impact: Looks unfinished on phones; wastes 30px of a 390px line.
fix: PageHeader primitive with items-start and icon aligned to the h1 cap height (or hide the icon below sm).

title: GitHub and documentation buttons point to a wrong owner and a deleted folder
evidence: Probe links: "View on GitHub" -> https://github.com/bernt-popp/kidney-genetics-db; "View Documentation" -> .../tree/main/docs. Actual remote is github.com/berntpopp/kidney-genetics-db and /docs no longer exists (moved to .planning/archive).
impact: Users following the only source/documentation links land on a 404; undermines the reproducibility claim.
fix: Fix owner to berntpopp, point docs to an existing target (README or API docs); add rel="noopener noreferrer" (missing on both target=_blank links at About.vue:139,218,245).

title: About ("Methodology" in SEO title) does not explain scoring, sources, releases, DOI or how to cite; copy is engineering-facing
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/about-desktop-light.png: "Core Concepts" lists "Exponential backoff retry with circuit breaker", "Configurable source weights", "Raw data ingestion + HGNC normalization"; no link to Data Sources, releases, Zenodo DOI, manuscript or citation (citation only in FAQ).
impact: Clinical geneticists cannot learn why a gene has its tier or how to cite a release; contradicts the product principles "evidence first" and "reproducible and citable".
fix: Rewrite Core Concepts for geneticists: scoring formula summary + link to manuscript, list of evidence sources linking /data-sources, current data release with DOI, citation block; drop retry/circuit-breaker internals.

title: Tier thresholds are written as percentages (score >=50%) while the same page and FAQ describe a 0–100 score
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/about-desktop-light.png tier list "4+ sources with robust evidence (score ≥50%)"; Evidence Scoring card "confidence score (0-100)".
impact: Ambiguous units for the core metric; a reader cannot tell whether 50% means 50 points.
fix: Use one unit everywhere (e.g. "score ≥ 50 of 100") in TIER_CONFIG descriptions.

title: White headings on light gradient headers (sky #0ea5e9, emerald #10b981) are below 3:1 at the lighter end
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/about-desktop-light.png "Gene Staging System" / "Multi-Source Integration" white 18px bold on #0ea5e9 (~2.8:1) and #10b981 (~2.5:1); same in dark.
impact: Large-text contrast failure (1.4.3); decorative gradients also break the systematized shadcn look.
fix: Replace gradient bands with the standard CardHeader and a tokenized icon disc; if kept, use darker stops (>=600/700).

title: Non-interactive concept cards lift on hover (translateY) implying they are clickable
evidence: About.vue:357 .concept-card:hover transform; computed cursor "auto"; cards have no link.
impact: False affordance: users click and nothing happens.
fix: Remove the hover lift or make the card link to the related page (e.g. /data-sources).

title: Tier legend rows squeeze description into a narrow column next to the chip on 390px
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/about-mobile-dark.png: "4+ sources with robust evidence (score ≥50%)" wraps to 3 lines beside the chip, ragged alignment.
impact: Key tier definitions are hard to scan on phones.
fix: Stack chip above description below sm (flex-col sm:flex-row) or use a definition list with fixed chip column.

title: "/docs" inline link is a relative href with target=_blank and no rel; FAQ says API docs are at /api/docs
evidence: About.vue:139 href="/docs"; FAQ.vue:122 "/api/docs (Swagger UI)" as plain text.
impact: Two different documented API-doc URLs; one may 404 depending on proxy.
fix: Use one config-driven API docs URL and link it in both places.

title: FAQ answers mention /api/docs, the Data Sources page, kidney-genetics.org and a citation but nothing is linked
evidence:
/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-faq-open-dark.png; FAQ.vue:122,116,130 render answers as plain strings via v-for of

.
impact: Users must retype URLs; citation lacks DOI link; no path from FAQ to the evidence views.
fix: Allow rich answers (RouterLink/a) in the FAQ data (render function or slot per item) and link DOI/PMID for the citation.

title: Hard-coded "over 5,000 genes" and "7 authoritative sources" in prose
evidence: FAQ.vue:84; source list in the same sentence names 8 items incl. "commercial diagnostic panels"; no release/version stated.
impact: Counts drift from the API and releases; violates "do not fabricate counts" and reproducibility.
fix: Pull gene/source counts from the statistics API at build time (prerender) or phrase without numbers and link /data-sources.

title: Question headings are 16px/400, same as answer-adjacent body text
evidence: Heading probe FAQ H2 16px weight 400; /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-faq-open-dark.png.
impact: Weak scan path for a Read-mode page.
fix: font-medium on AccordionTrigger in FAQ (or via SectionHeading token).

title: FAQ uses max-w-3xl centred column and an inline breadcrumb, unlike About/MCP (full container, PUBLIC_BREADCRUMBS)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-faq-open-dark.png vs /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/about-desktop-light.png: breadcrumb and h1 jump from x=96 to x=352 between sibling info pages.
impact: Content start jumps between sibling pages; two breadcrumb implementations.
fix: Shared ReadingLayout (breadcrumb + PageHeader + prose width) for About/FAQ/MCP; use PUBLIC_BREADCRUMBS.faq.

title: Copy button overlaps the end of long code lines (Claude Code command, config JSON)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/mcp-desktop-light.png "…kidney-geneti⧉.o" and /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/mcp-mobile-dark.png: icon sits on top of the scrolled command text; pr-12 is not honoured at the end of overflow content.
impact: The command a user must copy is visually corrupted; on mobile the URL is hidden under the icon.
fix: CodeBlock primitive with a header bar holding the copy button (outside the scroll area), or wrap <code> in an inline-block with padding-right.

title: Copy shows a tick even if clipboard write fails, and copy buttons share the non-unique name "Copy"
evidence: MCP.vue:288-296 calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without await/catch; aria-label "Copy" for 4 buttons (MCP.vue:105); only one live region on page (results mcp-live = 1, the toaster).
impact: Silent failure on insecure origins/denied permission; screen-reader users cannot tell which block a "Copy" button copies.
fix: await writeText, toast on success/failure, aria-label "Copy <client.title> snippet".

title: Server address card has a large empty band above its first line (CardContent pt-6 inside a Card that already pads)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/mcp-desktop-light.png: ~50px blank space at top of the "Server address" card.
impact: Looks broken; misaligned with sibling cards.
fix: Drop pt-6 (Card already has py-6) or use CardHeader.

title: Example prompts are rendered as violet Badge pills (look clickable, not copyable)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/mcp-desktop-light.png "Resolve PKD1 and show its evidence score" pills.
impact: Chip language overloaded: same pill as status labels; users try to click.
fix: Render as quoted list items or copyable inline code.

title: "Remember me" checkbox does nothing
evidence: Login.vue:43 rememberMe ref is never passed to authStore.login (Login.vue:47).
impact: Misleading control on a security-relevant form.
fix: Remove it, or wire it to the refresh-token lifetime in the API.

title: Empty-submit errors say "Required" instead of the schema messages
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-login-empty-dark.png shows "Required" under both fields; schema messages "Username or email is required" (Login.vue:23) are bypassed because untouched fields are undefined.
impact: Vague error copy; same on ForgotPassword/ResetPassword confirm.
fix: Use z.string({ required_error: ... }) or initialValues: { username: "", password: "" }.

title: Enter in the password field likely submits twice (native form submit + @keyup.enter)
evidence: Login.vue:126 @keyup.enter="onSubmit" on an input already inside <form @submit.prevent="onSubmit"> (code evidence, not network-verified).
impact: Two login requests per Enter: double rate-limit consumption and racing error states.
fix: Remove the @keyup.enter handler.

title: Native unstyled checkbox (16px, OS focus outline) instead of the shadcn Checkbox
evidence: results login-checkbox: outline "auto 1px", width 16; /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/login-desktop-light.png.
impact: Off-system control; weak focus indicator in dark.
fix: Use components/ui/checkbox (or remove with the no-op finding).

title: Page promises an email, then after submission says reset by email is not available
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/state-forgot-sent-light.png: subtitle "we'll send you instructions", then error "Password reset by email is not available. Ask an administrator to reset it."
impact: User fills the form for nothing; dead-end on the only recovery path.
fix: Read the feature flag (backend capability/config) and show the admin-contact message up front, hiding the form and the Login link "Forgot Password?" when disabled.

title: Success message has no role="status" (Reset has one)
evidence: ForgotPassword.vue:89 div without role; ResetPassword.vue:118 has role="status".
impact: Screen readers do not announce success.
fix: Use the shared FormAlert success variant with role="status".

title: Forgot page H1 "Reset Password" equals the purpose of /reset-password ("Choose a New Password")
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/forgot-desktop-light.png H1 "Reset Password".
impact: Users can confuse the request step with the set-new step.
fix: H1 "Forgot your password?"; button "Send reset link".

title: No-token error box text and link at 3.29:1
evidence: Probe reset-desktop-light low: 3.29 at 14px; /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/reset-desktop-light.png.
impact: See global destructive contrast.
fix: Fix via token:destructive.

title: Without a token the subtitle still says "The link from your email is valid for one hour"
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/reset-desktop-light.png subtitle above an error that says the link has no token.
impact: Contradictory copy in the error state.
fix: Hide the subtitle when !token.

title: Invalid-token error offers no next step
evidence: results reset-badtoken: "Invalid or expired reset token" with no link to request a new one (forgot flow also disabled).
impact: User cannot recover.
fix: Append "Request a new link" / admin contact to the error.

title: Read-only account data shown as disabled inputs at 50% opacity
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/profile-desktop-dark.png: Username/Email/Full Name look like placeholders; Profile.vue:108-116 Input disabled.
impact: Low-contrast values (disabled text is exempt but unreadable) and a fake form suggesting editability.
fix: Render as a <dl> description list; keep the "ask an administrator" note.

title: Admin role badge uses the destructive (error) colour
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/profile-desktop-dark.png red "admin" pill; Profile.vue:40 maps admin->destructive; contrast 3.81:1 light.
impact: Red means error elsewhere; role reads as a problem.
fix: Neutral or primary outline badge for roles; colour only if roles carry semantics defined in tokens.

title: Profile has no requiresAuth meta; redirect happens in onMounted after render
evidence: router/index.ts:140-144 lacks requiresAuth; Profile.vue:255-258 pushes /login after mount (anon visit ends on /login?redirect=/profile, /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/profile-anon.png).
impact: Anonymous users briefly see an empty profile shell; inconsistent with admin route guarding.
fix: Add meta.requiresAuth and rely on the router guard.

title: Password fields lack autocomplete hints and the confirm/current fields have no show toggle
evidence: Profile.vue:138-187: no autocomplete="current-password"/"new-password"; only new-password has an eye toggle.
impact: Password managers cannot help (WCAG 1.3.5 identify input purpose).
fix: Add autocomplete attributes; reuse a PasswordInput primitive with toggle on all three.

title: H1 is the bare number "404" in muted grey; the meaning ("Page not found") is a
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-content/notfound-desktop-light.png; NotFound.vue:3-4.
impact: Screen-reader users hear "404" as the page heading; muted 60px is the visual focus.
fix: h1 "Page not found" with a small "Error 404" eyebrow.

title: Submitting the empty gene search does nothing, with no feedback
evidence: results 404-empty: URL unchanged after clicking Search with empty input (NotFound.vue:45-48).
impact: Button appears broken.
fix: Navigate to /genes on empty query or disable the button until input.
